profile.headline: Senior Engineer/Tech Lead
profile.summary:
I'm result driven Senior Software Engineer with experience as Technical Lead, Feature Lead and Engineering Manager.
I've hands on experience in all phases of SDLC - Requirement gathering and analysis, creating RFC for design and collaborating with teams to finalize the design, project planning, development, implementation and compliance. 
Expertise in managing all aspects of technology infrastructure, in public cloud(AWS) or in hybrid Cloud – planning, designing, implementation, operational and external vendor management.

My core strengths are:  

Quickly adapting new technologies
Requirement gathering & analysis
Create and propose design that adheres to architecture and meets business requirements
Data modeling and database programming
Cross-team collaboration and negotiation
Planning, design, development, compliance and implementing new and existing software solutions
Excellent troubleshooting & problem solving abilities

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Tech lead and feature lead for Customer Experience (CX) team on company's SaaS Customer Data Platform (CDP).   Responsible for leading the CX team in developing and maintaining Scala based software.  Mentoring and on boarding junior team members.
Tech lead for Profile API greenfield project which facilitates querying customer data with < 200ms latency across multiple regions.  Designed with serverless components in AWS - Cognito, API Gateway, Lambda & DynamoDb.  Created RFC for the design, developed and delivered features within timeline despite challenges.  It leverages existing CDP components to reduce the cost and timeline.  Wrote Terraform script to create these AWS components as Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
positions.insights: Skills: Serverless Computing · AWS Lambda · Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon Cognito · API Gateways · Terraform · Scala · RPC

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
Quartz Risk Engine(QzRE) is Bank of America’s equity risk engine being developed in python based Quartz framework to compute risk measures on equity derivatives with low latency. I was feature lead to develop and implement an algorithm which distributes instruments in a portfolio across compute nodes to optimize cycle time across all nodes.
Flow risk is an existing Intraday Risk system to value equity derivatives in real-time. It is concurrent, distributed, low-latency application. I assisted with all facets of application development including project and support work, tooling, release management and testing.
I also engaged with the wider equity risk team in building out new risk service application(EqVS) which is
subscription based microservices built using Java and Google protobuf and communicate over socket with client.
Microservices provides product data, portfolio position data and real time market data to clients. It uses snapshot key-value pair database framework using in process BerkleyDb database. The framework provides storing and querying of market data at given point in time:
- Designed and built debug tool to browse binary data stored in protobuf format for a given snapshot to
help troubleshoot risk valuation issues. Front end is built using AngularJS.
- Created custom JMX annotations using Java reflection to expose any beans or services as JMX bean.
positions.insights: Skills: Core Java · Low Latency · Python (Programming Language) · Distributed Systems · Team Leadership

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Design, development, testing and deployment of Java applications that integrates OnDeck's financial platform with partners such as JP Morgan Chase.  Spring batch and REST API is used for integration.

positions.title: Assistant Vice President
positions.description:
Responsible for design, development and production support of core java applications which integrates various fixed income trading platforms such as ION, Bloomberg, Helix and Broadridge(ADP).
•	Evaluated JMS platforms to replace existing WebLogic.  Validated new architecture using criteria such as High Availability, Failover and Throughput.  JMeter was used to measure throughput.
•	Designed and developed Market data service web application to visualize market data from multiple sources and compare against trades and RFQs.  It was built on AngularJS framework using d3.js line chart and Hazelcast data grid.
•	Designed and Implemented company wide subscription based data provider framework using Java and Spring.  This framework uses REST end points and JMS for integration.
•	Business analysis, requirement gathering and development of java component to STP DealMaker trades to Bloomberg TOMS using WebSphere MQ and Inforalgo.
•	Designed and developed a java component to consume FIX message using Quickfixj.

positions.title: Director of Technology
positions.description:
Responsible for coaching and managing team of engineers to deliver SaaS e-Commerce platform to sell tickets and merchandise to consumers in Cloud infrastructure.
Performed evaluation, implementation and execution of technology plan – System design, administration, technical support and vendor management to meet current & future business needs.   
Plan and execute product road map that consistently deliver new product features, improve capacity and security to provide business the technology platform to continuously evolve and prepare for future.  
Lead the team of Engineers to achieve customer focused and timely market solutions.

positions.title: Advisory Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Lead, designed and developed multi-tired J2EE web applications incorporating latest open source tools and technologies.  Practiced sound software development practices such as Agile methodology and Test driven development.  As a technical owner I was also responsible for operational support & planning.

positions.title: WebSphere Portal Developer
positions.description: Delivered Web Presence portal application using IBM WebSphere Portal Server, J2EE, Web Services, XML, XSLT and Ant.  Involved in designing and development of portlets, portal deployment, development server setup and all facet of testing.  Optimized data from Enterprise Content Management system to be consumed by portal.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Provided consulting, prototyping and designing applications using Lotus advanced web technologies to run IBM's intranet site and support sales activity.

- Facilitated Software group sales by leading, designing and developing SWG Answer Network (SWAN) application which provides timely technical expertise to sales person to assist software sale.  This solution demonstrated efficient handling of large amount of data using Lotus Notes, Java and SAX parsing technologies.

-  Developed web based applications for Lotus Intranet, customized Lotus Quickr and Lotus Sametime products.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: Consulting, designing and developing applications on client site, working with client directly using Lotus Notes, C & Java.  Worked with wide range of client including retail, Pharmaceutical & Manufacturing companies.
